cq1_1.question: Which vehicle capabilities does the assigned task require?
cq1_1.description: Capabilities a mission's assigned task requires, with the requirement (or class axiom) that supports each one. Give the task and, if known, the mission.

task.description: Task name or ID, e.g. 'Observe an inspection area' or ObserveAreaTask

mission.description: Mission ID, e.g. MissionAlpha. Omit to match any mission
